introHtml: Custom 2 oz personal care items are ideal for TSA-compliant travel kits, hotel amenities, or product sampling. Unlike larger sizes, these compact containers fit easily into purses or welcome bags while still providing enough product for multiple uses. Choose from lotions, hand sanitizers, or sunscreens in 2 oz bottles or tubes, and decorate with your logo using screen printing or pressure-sensitive labels for a polished look at trade shows or corporate events.
